_meta.description: Marketing approval orchestrator. Triggers on reply_proposal_status_changed -> pending_approval. Pulls proposal preview, builds approval-card instruction for OpenFang approval-handler agent, which sends via Telegram (default) or Discord. User responds APPROVE/REJECT via the chat, OpenFang's brain-gateway routes to marketing /api/reply_proposals/{id}/approve with the token.
dsvgo_notes: Approval-token is NEVER in this workflow. Curator stores it securely from /request_approval response.
Card-preview shows only subject + draft_to_email — full body is curator-UI only.
OpenFang handles channel-credentials (DPAPI). n8n only triggers via /api/agents/{id}/message.
